newsitem.title: UK: UK rail regulator agrees new services in southwest.
newsitem.headline: UK rail regulator agrees new services in southwest.

text.p: The UK's rail regulator on Friday said it had agreed to allow South Wales & West Railway Ltd to run new through services in the southwest.
The decision follows an appeal by South Wales & West in March against a decision by Railtrack Plc that it did not have the right to operate certain services.

The services comprise those between Manchester and Penzance via Newport, Bristol and Plymouth; Liverpool and Portsmouth via Newport, Bristol and Southampton; and Manchester and London via Newport, Bristol and Salisbury.
